facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; no exchange controls on foreign income.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: banks like HSBC offer personal foreign-currency accounts.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Start as a sole trader at once; register with HMRC above £1,000 a year.
facts.L2_tax_id: Your UTR, issued by HMRC when you register for Self Assessment.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed above a £12,570 allowance, plus Class 4 National Insurance.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 20% VAT; register once turnover passes £90,000 a year.
facts.L5_data_protection: UK GDPR; most businesses pay the ICO data protection fee.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online buyers can cancel within 14 days of receiving goods.
facts.L7_incentives: £1,000 trading allowance: tiny side income needs no registration or tax.

watch_out.text: Zero-rated sales count toward the £90,000 VAT threshold.
Register for Self Assessment once you earn over £1,000 in a tax year.
